title: Advancing the Science of Visual Intelligence
paragraphs: Our goal is to advance how intelligent systems perceive, interpret and interact with the visual world.

Through scientific research, experimentation and interdisciplinary collaboration, we aim to develop responsible computer vision technologies that support discovery and address meaningful real-world challenges.

We seek to create an environment where students, researchers and collaborators can explore new ideas, strengthen their technical understanding and contribute to the advancement of intelligent systems.
